v.7: indeed your Lord’s punishment will surely befall.
v.8: There is none who can avert it.
v.9: On the day when the sky whirls violently,
v.10: and the mountains move with an awful motion:
v.11: woe to the deniers on that day
v.12: —those who play around in vain talk,
v.13: the day when they will be shoved forcibly toward the fire of hell, [and told:]
v.14: ‘This is the Fire which you used to deny!
v.15: Is this, then, [also] magic, or is it you who do not perceive?
v.16: Enter it, and it will be the same for you whether you are patient or impatient. You are only being requited for what you used to do.’
v.17: Indeed the Godwary will be amid gardens and bliss,
v.18: rejoicing because of what their Lord has given them, and that their Lord has saved them from the punishment of hell.
v.19: [They will be told:] ‘Enjoy your food and drink, [as a reward] for what you used to do.’
v.20: They will be reclining on arrayed couches, and We will wed them to big-eyed houris.
v.21: The faithful and their descendants who followed them in faith—We will make their descendants join them, and We will not stint anything from [the reward of] their deeds. Every person is hostage to what he has earned.
v.22: We will provide them with fruits and meat, such as they desire.
v.23: There they will pass from hand to hand a cup wherein there will be neither any vain talk nor sinful speech.
v.24: They will be waited upon by their youths, as if they were guarded pearls.
v.25: They will turn to one another, questioning each other.
v.26: They will say, ‘Indeed, aforetime, we used to be apprehensive about our families.
v.27: But Allah showed us favour and He saved us from the punishment of the [infernal] miasma.
v.28: We used to supplicate Him aforetime. Indeed He is the All-benign, the All-merciful.’
v.29: So admonish. By your Lord’s blessing, you are not a soothsayer, nor mad.
v.30: Do they say, ‘[He is] a poet, for whom we await a fatal accident’?
v.31: Say, ‘Wait! I too am waiting along with you.’
v.32: Is it their intellect which prompts them to [say] this, or are they a rebellious lot?
v.33: Do they say, ‘He has improvised it [himself]?’ Rather, they have no faith!
v.34: Let them bring a discourse like it, if they are truthful.
v.35: Were they created from nothing? Or are they [their own] creators?
v.36: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they have no certainty!
v.37: Do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or do they control [them]?
v.38: Do they have a ladder [leading up to heaven] whereby they eavesdrop? If so, let their eavesdropper produce a manifest authority.
v.39: Does He have daughters while you have sons?
v.40: Do you ask them for a reward, so that they are [wary of] being weighed down with debt?
v.41: Do they have [access to] the Unseen, which they write down?
v.42: Do they seek to outmaneuver [Allah]? But it is the faithless who are the outmaneuvered ones!
v.43: Do they have any god other than Allah? Clear is Allah of any partners that they may ascribe [to Him]!
v.44: Were they to see a fragment falling from the sky, they would say, ‘A cumulous cloud.’
v.45: So leave them until they encounter the day when they will be thunderstruck,
v.46: the day when their guile will not avail them in any way, nor will they be helped.
v.47: Indeed there is a punishment besides that for those who do wrong, but most of them do not know.
v.48: So submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord, for indeed you fare before Our eyes. And celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise [at dawn],
v.49: and also glorify Him during the night and at the receding of the stars.
